design.stage: EAB round 12: FEMNIST replication of independent split selection and planner-predicted verification
design.prior_knowledge_disclosed: Designers know the CIFAR budgetconf results (H1 held) and the inherited FEMNIST joint-naming results (m=62 random labels: joint below the strongest public learner at n=1k; about 32 of 62 classes missing per label draw).
design.dataset: femnist62 (release-granularity inputs, DINOv2/128 features, K=C=62 public regions)
design.writers: the 2600 private writers are split by a seeded permutation (seed 20261022) into pool A (1300, development only) and pool B (1300, confirmation only); no writer is in both
design.client_sampling: 1000 distinct writers per cohort without replacement from the phase pool
design.records: each writer keeps all original records; a seeded per-writer permutation puts floor(0.8*count) records in training and the rest in a held-out set used only for verification (at least one held-out record)

evaluation_records.development: public validation split (4685 records of disjoint writers)
evaluation_records.confirmation: public test split (4549 records); never loaded in development

design.epsilon_note: eps=10 probes where class evidence becomes certifiable at C=62; eps=.1 is omitted (no target certifiable on CIFAR)
design.composition: sequential, one total budget per deployment

teacher.model: linear softmax head on frozen 128-d features

design.candidate_family: public count matching, eight joint weights, private centered and coverage; exact LOO accuracy on the 62 labels (as CIFAR)

targets.gain>0: private candidate and client-mean gain lower > 0
targets.all recalls>0: and every class recall lower bound > 0
targets.all recalls>=.50: and every class recall lower bound >= .5

design.truth: targets are judged on the clean client-mean held-out statistics of the cohort (the quantity the release certifies); false accept = accepted while the clean statistic misses the target
design.bands: as budgetconf (gain lower bound, direct linear-sum class bands); alpha .025 each
design.selection: as budgetconf: per target and eps, grid phi maximizing mean validation accuracy of the published classifier; ties by |phi-.5| then phi; frozen in SELECTION.json before any confirmation case

planner.inputs: development clean client-mean statistics per case (gain, class masses, correct masses) of private candidates; 0 for public candidates
planner.model: release-eab3 planning.accept_probability with the configuration rho fractions
planner.prediction: mean predicted acceptance over development cases = predicted confirmation acceptance, for fixed and frozen configurations of every target/eps
planner.frozen_in: PREDICTIONS.json, written with SELECTION.json before any confirmation case

primary.F1: every fixed and frozen target/eps cell: |planner prediction - confirmation acceptance| <= 5 points
primary.F2: every fixed and frozen target/eps cell: false-accept rate <= 5% of accepted cases

predictions: no frozen cell more than 1 point below fixed in confirmation test accuracy
gain>0 is accepted more often than all recalls>0 at every eps under the fixed split
no class target is accepted in more than 5% of cases at eps<=3
descriptive: class tail of classifiers published by the gain rule
